name: finiteJet_tateExt_isSheafyComplete
statement:
theorem finiteJet_tateExt_isSheafyComplete (n : ℕ) :
    letI
proof:
:= mvTateAlgebraTopology' (A := JetA F) n
    haveI := mvTate_isTateRing (A := JetA F) n
    haveI := mvTate_t2Space (A := JetA F) n
    haveI := mvTate_nonarchimedean (A := JetA F) n
    haveI := mvTateAlgebraTopology'_isTopologicalRing (A := JetA F) n
    haveI : @CompleteSpace ↥(restrictedMvPowerSeriesSubring n (JetA F))
      (IsTopologicalAddGroup.rightUniformSpace _) := finiteJet_tateExt_completeSpace F n
    IsSheafyComplete ↥(restrictedMvPowerSeriesSubring n (JetA F)) := by
  let _i := mvTateAlgebraTopology' (A := JetA F) n
  have := mvTate_isTateRing (A := JetA F) n
  have := mvTate_t2Space (A := JetA F) n
  have := mvTate_nonarchimedean (A := JetA F) n
  have := mvTateAlgebraTopology'_isTopologicalRing (A := JetA F) n
  have : @CompleteSpace ↥(restrictedMvPowerSeriesSubring n (JetA F))
      (IsTopologicalAddGroup.rightUniformSpace _) := finiteJet_tateExt_completeSpace F n
  exact (isSheafyComplete_congr (UnitDiscExample.restrictedGaussEquiv (JetA F) n)
    (gaussToTate_continuous F n) (tateToGauss_continuous F n)).mp
    (ext_isSheafyComplete F n)

name: isRestricted_iff
statement:
lemma isRestricted_iff {f : PowerSeries R} : IsRestricted c f ↔
    ∀ ε, 0 < ε → ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → ‖‖(coeff n) f‖ * c ^ n‖ < ε
proof:
:= by
  simp [IsRestricted, NormedAddCommGroup.tendsto_atTop]

name: isRestricted_iff_abs
statement: lemma isRestricted_iff_abs (f : PowerSeries R) : IsRestricted c f ↔ IsRestricted |c| f
proof:
:= by
  simp [isRestricted_iff]

name: zero
statement: lemma zero : IsRestricted c (0 : PowerSeries R)
proof:
:= by
  simp [IsRestricted]

name: one
statement: lemma one : IsRestricted c (1 : PowerSeries R)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isRestricted_iff, coeff_one, norm_mul, norm_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  refine fun _ _ ↦ ⟨1, fun n hn ↦ ?_ ⟩
  split
  · lia
  · simpa

name: monomial
statement: lemma monomial (n : ℕ) (a : R) : IsRestricted c (monomial n a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [monomial_eq_mk, isRestricted_iff, coeff_mk, norm_mul, norm_pow,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_norm]
  refine fun _ _ ↦ ⟨n + 1, fun _ _ ↦ ?_⟩
  split
  · lia
  · simpa

name: C
statement: lemma C (a : R) : IsRestricted c (C a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [monomial_zero_eq_C_apply] using monomial c 0 a

name: add
statement:
lemma add {f g : PowerSeries R} (hf : IsRestricted c f) (hg : IsRestricted c g) :
    IsRestricted c (f + g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isRestricted_iff, map_add, norm_mul, norm_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs] at ⊢ hf hg
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨fN, hfN⟩ := hf (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨gN, hgN⟩ := hg (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  simp only [abs_norm] at hfN hgN ⊢
  refine ⟨max fN gN, fun n hn ↦ ?_ ⟩
  calc _ ≤ ‖(coeff n) f‖ * |c| ^ n + ‖(coeff n) g‖ * |c| ^ n := by grw [norm_add_le, add_mul]
       _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := by gcongr <;> grind
       _ = ε := by ring

name: neg
statement: lemma neg {f : PowerSeries R} (hf : IsRestricted c f) : IsRestricted c (-f)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [isRestricted_iff] using hf

name: smul
statement: lemma smul {f : PowerSeries R} (hf : IsRestricted c f) (r : R) : IsRestricted c (r • f)
proof:
:= by
  if h : r = 0 then simpa [h] using zero c else
  simp_rw [isRestricted_iff, norm_mul, norm_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_norm] at ⊢ hf
  intro ε _
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hf (ε / ‖r‖) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨n, fun N hN ↦ ?_⟩
  calc _ ≤ ‖r‖ * ‖(coeff N) f‖ * |c| ^ N :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg (norm_mul_le _ _) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp)
       _ < ‖r‖ * (ε / ‖r‖) := by
        rw [mul_assoc]; aesop
       _ = ε := mul_div_cancel₀ _ (by aesop)

name: convergenceSet_BddAbove
statement:
lemma convergenceSet_BddAbove {f : PowerSeries R} (hf : IsRestricted c f) :
    BddAbove (convergenceSet c f)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isRestricted_iff] at hf
  obtain ⟨N, hf⟩ := by simpa using (hf 1)
  rw [bddAbove_def, convergenceSet]
  use max 1 (max' (image (fun i ↦ ‖coeff i f‖ * c ^ i) (range (N + 1))) (by simp))
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, le_sup_iff, forall_exists_index, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff]
  intro i
  rcases le_total i N with h | h
  · right
    apply le_max'
    simp only [mem_image, mem_range]
    exact ⟨i, by lia, rfl⟩
  · left
    calc _ ≤ ‖(coeff i) f‖ * |c ^ i| := by bound
         _ ≤ 1 := by simpa using (hf i h).le

name: mul
statement:
lemma mul {f g : PowerSeries R} (hf : IsRestricted c f) (hg : IsRestricted c g) :
    IsRestricted c (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, fBound1⟩ := (bddAbove_iff_exists_ge 1).mp (convergenceSet_BddAbove _
    ((isRestricted_iff_abs c f).mp hf))
  obtain ⟨b, hb, gBound1⟩ := (bddAbove_iff_exists_ge 1).mp (convergenceSet_BddAbove _
    ((isRestricted_iff_abs c g).mp hg))
  simp only [convergenceSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq, forall_exists_index, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff]
    at fBound1 gBound1
  simp only [isRestricted_iff, norm_mul, norm_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_norm,
    PowerSeries.coeff_mul] at ⊢ hf hg
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨Nf, fBound2⟩ := (hf (ε / (max a b))) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨Ng, gBound2⟩ := (hg (ε / (max a b))) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨2 * max Nf Ng, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨fst, snd⟩, hi, ultrametric⟩ := exists_norm_finsetSum_le (Finset.antidiagonal n)
    (fun a ↦ (coeff a.1) f * (coeff a.2) g)
  obtain ⟨rfl⟩ := by simpa using hi (⟨(0, n), by simp⟩)
  calc _ ≤ ‖(coeff fst) f * (coeff snd) g‖ * |c| ^ (fst + snd) := by bound
       _ ≤ ‖(coeff fst) f‖ * |c| ^ fst * (‖(coeff snd) g‖ * |c| ^ snd) := by
        grw [norm_mul_le]
        #adaptation_note
        /
        Broken in `nightly-2025-10-26`: this was by `grind`, but is now no longer supported.
        See https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/pull/10970.
        -/
        rw [pow_add]
        grind
  have : max Nf Ng ≤ fst ∨ max Nf Ng ≤ snd := by lia
  rcases this with this | this
  · calc _ < ε / max a b * b := by
          grw [gBound1 snd]
          gcongr
          exact fBound2 fst (by omega)
         _ ≤ ε := by
          rw [div_mul_comm, mul_le_iff_le_one_left ‹_›]
          bound
  · calc _ < a * (ε / max a b) := by
          grw [fBound1 fst]
          gcongr
          exact gBound2 snd (by omega)
         _ ≤ ε := by
          rw [mul_div_left_comm, mul_le_iff_le_one_right ‹_›]
          bound

name: finSuccEquiv_restricted_image_restricted
statement:
lemma finSuccEquiv_restricted_image_restricted
    (f : MvPowerSeries.Restricted R c) (i : ℕ): MvPowerSeries.IsRestrictedGauss (Fin.tail c)
    (PowerSeries.coeff i (MvPowerSeries.finSuccEquiv R n f.1))
proof:
:= by
  have h := (f.2.comp (Finsupp.cons_right_injective i).tendsto_cofinite).const_mul (c 0 ^ i)⁻¹
  rw [mul_zero] at h
  refine h.congr (fun t ↦ ?_)
  simp only [MvPowerSeries.coeff_coeff_finSuccEquiv, Finsupp.prod_pow, Function.comp_apply,
    Fin.prod_univ_succ, Finsupp.cons_zero, mul_left_comm,
    inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (pow_ne_zero _ (StrongPos_pos c 0).ne')]
  rfl

name: Finsupp.cons_injective
statement:
lemma Finsupp.cons_injective (n : ℕ) (a : (Unit →₀ ℕ) → Fin n →₀ ℕ ) :
    Function.Injective (fun (t : Unit →₀ ℕ) ↦ Finsupp.cons (t ()) (a t))
proof:
:= by
  intro s t hst
  suffices (Finsupp.cons (s ()) (a s)) 0 = (Finsupp.cons (t ()) (a t)) 0 by
    ext
    exact this
  congr

name: Finsupp.cons_uncurry_injective
statement:
lemma Finsupp.cons_uncurry_injective {n : ℕ} {M : Type u_1} [Zero M] :
    Function.Injective (Function.uncurry (Finsupp.cons (n := n) (M := M)))
proof:
:=
  Function.Injective2.uncurry (Finsupp.cons_injective2)

name: Finsupp.cons_uncurry_surjective
statement:
lemma Finsupp.cons_uncurry_surjective {n : ℕ} {M : Type u_1} [Zero M] :
    Function.Surjective (Function.uncurry (Finsupp.cons (n := n) (M := M)))
proof:
:=
  fun s ↦ ⟨(s 0, Finsupp.tail s), Finsupp.cons_tail s⟩

name: Finsupp.cons_uncurry_cofinite
statement:
lemma Finsupp.cons_uncurry_cofinite {n : ℕ} {M : Type u_1} [Zero M] :
    (cofinite : Filter (Fin (n + 1) →₀ M)) =
    Filter.map (Function.uncurry (Finsupp.cons (M := M) (n := n))) cofinite
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm Finsupp.cons_uncurry_surjective.le_map_cofinite
      Finsupp.cons_uncurry_injective.tendsto_cofinite

name: MvPowerSeries.funSuccEquivSymm_coeff
statement:
lemma MvPowerSeries.funSuccEquivSymm_coeff {M : Type*} [CommRing M] (n : ℕ) (s : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ)
    (f : PowerSeries (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) M)) :
    MvPowerSeries.coeff s ((MvPowerSeries.finSuccEquiv M n).symm f) =
    MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.tail s) (PowerSeries.coeff (s 0) f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(Finsupp.cons_tail s).symm, ← MvPowerSeries.coeff_coeff_finSuccEquiv,
    AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

name: finSuccEquiv_restricted_image
statement:
lemma finSuccEquiv_restricted_image :
    (MvPowerSeries.isSubring (R := R) c).map (MvPowerSeries.finSuccEquiv R n).toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
    (PowerSeries.isSubring (R := MvPowerSeries.Restricted R (Fin.tail c)) (c 0)).map
      (PowerSeries.map (MvPowerSeries.isSubring (R := R) (Fin.tail c)).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    set h : PowerSeries ↥(MvPowerSeries.isSubring (Fin.tail c)) :=
      PowerSeries.mk fun i ↦ ⟨PowerSeries.coeff i (MvPowerSeries.finSuccEquiv R n f),
      finSuccEquiv_restricted_image_restricted n c ⟨f, hf⟩ i⟩
    refine ⟨h, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show PowerSeries.IsRestricted (c 0) _
      refine (Restricted.isRestricted_iff_cofinite (c 0)).mpr ?_
      choose a ha using fun i : ℕ ↦ MvRestricted.gaussNorm_achieved (Fin.tail c)
        (fun _ ↦ (StrongPos_pos c _).le)
        (PowerSeries.coeff i h)
      have hinj : Function.Injective (fun i : ℕ ↦ (Finsupp.cons i (a i) :
          Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ)) := by
        intro s t hst
        simpa using congrArg (fun x : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ => x 0) hst
      refine Filter.Tendsto.congr
        (f₁ := (fun s => ‖(MvPowerSeries.coeff s) f‖ * s.prod fun x1 x2 => c x1 ^ x2) ∘
          fun i : ℕ => Finsupp.cons i (a i))
        (fun i ↦ ?_) (hf.comp hinj.tendsto_cofinite)
      have hcoeffh : ((PowerSeries.coeff i) h).1 =
          PowerSeries.coeff i (MvPowerSeries.finSuccEquiv R n f) := by
        simp only [h, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
      have hat : ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff (a i) (((PowerSeries.coeff i) h).1)‖ *
          (a i).prod (Fin.tail c · ^ ·) =
          MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm norm (Fin.tail c) (((PowerSeries.coeff i) h).1) := ha i
      rw [hcoeffh] at hat
      show ‖(MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.cons i (a i))) f‖ *
          ((Finsupp.cons i (a i)).prod fun x1 x2 => c x1 ^ x2) =
        ‖((PowerSeries.coeff i) h : MvPowerSeries.Restricted R (Fin.tail c))‖ * c 0 ^ i
      rw [show ‖((PowerSeries.coeff i) h : MvPowerSeries.Restricted R (Fin.tail c))‖ =
          MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm norm (Fin.tail c) (((PowerSeries.coeff i) h).1) from rfl,
        hcoeffh, ← hat, ← MvPowerSeries.coeff_coeff_finSuccEquiv]
      simp_rw [Finsupp.prod_pow, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Finsupp.cons_zero, Finsupp.cons_succ,
        Fin.tail]
      ring
    · ext; simp [h]
  · rintro ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(MvPowerSeries.finSuccEquiv R n).symm
        (PowerSeries.map (MvPowerSeries.isSubring (Fin.tail c)).subtype h), ?_, ?_⟩
    · show MvPowerSeries.IsRestrictedGauss c _
      let h' : PowerSeries (MvPowerSeries.Restricted R (Fin.tail c)) := h
      have hh : PowerSeries.IsRestricted (c 0) h' := hh
      rw [Restricted.isRestricted_iff_cofinite] at hh
      set F : (Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ) → ℝ := fun s ↦
        ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff s ((MvPowerSeries.finSuccEquiv R n).symm
          (PowerSeries.map (MvPowerSeries.isSubring (R := R) (Fin.tail c)).subtype h))‖ *
          s.prod (c · ^ ·)
      have hFΦ : ∀ (p : ℕ × (Fin n →₀ ℕ)), (F ∘ (Function.uncurry (Finsupp.cons))) p =
          ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 (PowerSeries.coeff p.1 h).val‖ * p.2.prod (Fin.tail c · ^ ·) *
          c 0 ^ p.1 := by
        rintro ⟨k, x⟩
        unfold F
        simp only [MvPowerSeries.funSuccEquivSymm_coeff, PowerSeries.coeff_map,
          Subring.subtype_apply, Finsupp.prod_pow, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Function.comp_apply,
          Function.uncurry_apply_pair, Finsupp.tail_cons, Finsupp.cons_zero, Finsupp.cons_succ,
          Fin.tail]
        ring
      rw [MvPowerSeries.IsRestrictedGauss, Finsupp.cons_uncurry_cofinite, Filter.tendsto_map'_iff,
        Filter.coprod_cofinite.symm]
      apply Tendsto.coprod_of_prod_top_right
      · intro s hs
        have hψ : Tendsto (fun x ↦ ∑ j ∈ hs.toFinset, ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff x
            (PowerSeries.coeff j h).val‖ * x.prod (Fin.tail c · ^ ·) * c 0 ^ j) cofinite (𝓝 0) := by
          have htends : ∀ j, Tendsto (fun x ↦ ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff x (PowerSeries.coeff j h).val‖ *
              x.prod (Fin.tail c · ^ ·) * c 0 ^ j) cofinite (𝓝 0) := fun j ↦ by
            simpa using ((PowerSeries.coeff j h).2).mul_const (c 0 ^ j)
          simpa using tendsto_finsetSum hs.toFinset (fun j _ ↦ htends j)
        refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds (hψ.comp tendsto_snd)
          (Eventually.of_forall fun p ↦ ?_) ?_
        · rw [hFΦ]
          refine mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) ?_) (pow_nonneg (StrongPos_pos c 0).le _)
          exact Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ pow_nonneg (StrongPos_pos c i.succ).le _)
        · filter_upwards [tendsto_fst.eventually (eventually_principal.mpr fun _ ha ↦ ha)] with p hp
          rw [hFΦ]
          refine Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j ↦ ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2
            (PowerSeries.coeff j h).val‖ * p.2.prod (Fin.tail c · ^ ·) * c 0 ^ j) (fun j _ ↦ ?_)
            (hs.mem_toFinset.mpr hp)
          refine mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) ?_) (pow_nonneg (StrongPos_pos c 0).le _)
          exact Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ pow_nonneg (StrongPos_pos c _).le _)
      · refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds (hh.comp tendsto_fst)
          ?_ ?_
        all_goals intro p; rw [hFΦ]
        · refine mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) ?_) (pow_nonneg (StrongPos_pos c 0).le _)
          exact Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ pow_nonneg (StrongPos_pos c i.succ).le _)
        · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (MvPowerSeries.le_gaussNorm norm (Fin.tail c)
            (PowerSeries.coeff p.1 h').val (MvRestricted.hasGaussNorm (Fin.tail c)
            (PowerSeries.coeff p.1 h')) p.2) (pow_nonneg (StrongPos_pos c 0).le _)
    · simp [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: MvRestricted.map_finSuccEquiv
statement:
lemma MvRestricted.map_finSuccEquiv (f : MvPowerSeries.Restricted R c) :
    PowerSeries.map (MvPowerSeries.isSubring (R := R) (Fin.tail c)).subtype
        (MvRestricted.finSuccEquiv R n c f).1 = MvPowerSeries.finSuccEquiv R n f.1
proof:
:= by
  let e2 := Subring.equivMapOfInjective
    (PowerSeries.isSubring (R := MvPowerSeries.Restricted R (Fin.tail c)) (c 0))
    (PowerSeries.map (MvPowerSeries.isSubring (R := R) (Fin.tail c)).subtype)
    (PowerSeries.map_injective _ Subtype.val_injective)
  show (e2 (e2.symm ((RingEquiv.subringCongr (finSuccEquiv_restricted_image n c))
    (RingEquiv.subringMap (MvPowerSeries.finSuccEquiv R n).toRingEquiv f)))).1 = _
  rw [e2.apply_symm_apply ((RingEquiv.subringCongr (finSuccEquiv_restricted_image n c))
    (RingEquiv.subringMap (MvPowerSeries.finSuccEquiv R n).toRingEquiv f))]
  rfl

name: MvRestricted.coeff_finSuccEquiv
statement:
lemma MvRestricted.coeff_finSuccEquiv (f : MvPowerSeries.Restricted R c) (i : ℕ) :
    (PowerSeries.coeff i (MvRestricted.finSuccEquiv R n c f).1).1 =
    PowerSeries.coeff i (MvPowerSeries.finSuccEquiv R n f.1)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (PowerSeries.map (MvPowerSeries.isSubring (R := R) (Fin.tail c)).subtype)
      ((MvRestricted.finSuccEquiv R n c f).1) = MvPowerSeries.finSuccEquiv R n f.1 :=
    MvRestricted.map_finSuccEquiv n c f
  have h3 := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff i) h2
  rw [show (PowerSeries.coeff i) ((PowerSeries.map
        (MvPowerSeries.isSubring (R := R) (Fin.tail c)).subtype)
        ((MvRestricted.finSuccEquiv R n c f).1)) =
      (MvPowerSeries.isSubring (R := R) (Fin.tail c)).subtype
        ((PowerSeries.coeff i) ((MvRestricted.finSuccEquiv R n c f).1)) from
    PowerSeries.coeff_map ..] at h3
  exact h3

name: MvRestricted_finSuccEquiv_norm_eq_norm
statement:
lemma MvRestricted_finSuccEquiv_norm_eq_norm (f : MvPowerSeries.Restricted R c) :
    Restricted.gaussNorm _ (c 0) (MvRestricted.finSuccEquiv R n c f) =
    MvRestricted.gaussNorm R c f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Restricted.gaussNorm, MvRestricted.gaussNorm, MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm]
  simp only [Finsupp.prod_pow, Finset.univ_unique, PUnit.default_eq_unit, Finset.prod_singleton]
  simp_rw [MvRestricted.norm_eq, MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm]
  simp_rw [Real.iSup_mul_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg ((StrongPos_pos c 0).le) _)]
  
  have hpointwise : ∀ (t : Unit →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin n →₀ ℕ),
      (‖MvPowerSeries.coeff i (MvPowerSeries.coeff t (MvRestricted.finSuccEquiv R n c f).1).1‖ *
        i.prod (fun x1 x2 => Fin.tail c x1 ^ x2)) * c 0 ^ t PUnit.unit =
      ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.cons (t ()) i) f.1‖ *
        ∏ a, c a ^ (Finsupp.cons (t ()) i) a := by
    intro t i
    have ht : MvPowerSeries.coeff t (MvRestricted.finSuccEquiv R n c f).1 =
        PowerSeries.coeff (t ()) (MvRestricted.finSuccEquiv R n c f).1 := by
      conv_lhs => rw [show t = Finsupp.single () (t ()) from Finsupp.unique_single t]
      rfl
    rw [ht, MvRestricted.coeff_finSuccEquiv, MvPowerSeries.coeff_coeff_finSuccEquiv,
      Fin.prod_univ_succ, Finsupp.prod_pow]
    simp only [Finsupp.cons_zero, Finsupp.cons_succ, Fin.tail]
    ring
  
  have hbd : BddAbove (Set.range (fun (p : (Unit →₀ ℕ) × (Fin n →₀ ℕ)) =>
      (‖MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2
          (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 (MvRestricted.finSuccEquiv R n c f).1).1‖ *
        p.2.prod (fun x1 x2 => Fin.tail c x1 ^ x2)) * c 0 ^ p.1 PUnit.unit)) := by
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := MvRestricted.hasGaussNorm c f
    refine ⟨B, ?_⟩
    rintro y ⟨⟨t, i⟩, rfl⟩
    show (‖MvPowerSeries.coeff i (MvPowerSeries.coeff t (MvRestricted.finSuccEquiv R n c f).1).1‖ *
        i.prod (fun x1 x2 => Fin.tail c x1 ^ x2)) * c 0 ^ t PUnit.unit ≤ B
    rw [hpointwise t i]
    exact hB ⟨Finsupp.cons (t ()) i, by simp [Finsupp.prod_pow]⟩
  
  rw [← ciSup_prod hbd]
  
  let e : (Unit →₀ ℕ) × (Fin n →₀ ℕ) ≃ (Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ) :=
    { toFun := fun p => Finsupp.cons (p.1 ()) p.2
      invFun := fun s => (Finsupp.single () (s 0), Finsupp.tail s)
      left_inv := by
        rintro ⟨t, i⟩
        show (Finsupp.single () (Finsupp.cons (t ()) i 0),
            Finsupp.tail (Finsupp.cons (t ()) i)) = (t, i)
        rw [Finsupp.cons_zero, Finsupp.tail_cons, ← Finsupp.unique_single t]
      right_inv := by
        intro s
        show Finsupp.cons ((Finsupp.single () (s 0)) ()) (Finsupp.tail s) = s
        rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same, Finsupp.cons_tail] }
  refine e.iSup_congr ?_
  rintro ⟨t, i⟩
  exact (hpointwise t i).symm

name: MvRestricted.isCompleteSpace'
statement:
lemma MvRestricted.isCompleteSpace' [CompleteSpace R] :
    CompleteSpace (PowerSeries.Restricted (MvPowerSeries.Restricted R (Fin.tail c)) (c 0))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    haveI : CompleteSpace (MvPowerSeries.Restricted R (Fin.tail c)) := IsometryEquiv.completeSpace
      (foo_isom _)
    exact Restricted.isCompleteSpace _
  | succ n ih =>
    haveI : CompleteSpace (MvPowerSeries.Restricted R (Fin.tail c)) :=
      IsometryEquiv.completeSpace (MvRestricted.finSuccIsometry _ _ _)
    exact Restricted.isCompleteSpace _

name: hasGaussNorm_iff
statement:
lemma hasGaussNorm_iff :
    HasGaussNorm v c f ↔ BddAbove (Set.range (fun (t : ℕ) ↦ (v (coeff t f) * c ^ t)))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  all_goals
  intro hf
  suffices (Set.range (fun (t : ℕ) ↦ (v (coeff t f) * c ^ t))) =
      Set.range fun t ↦ v ((MvPowerSeries.coeff t) f) * t.prod fun _ x2 ↦ c ^ x2 by
    simpa only [HasGaussNorm, MvPowerSeries.HasGaussNorm, ← this] using hf
  refine Set.ext (fun _ ↦ ?_)
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Finsupp.prod_pow, Finset.univ_unique, PUnit.default_eq_unit,
    Finset.prod_singleton]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨y, _⟩ := h
    use Finsupp.single () y
    aesop
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h
    use (y PUnit.unit)
    simpa [coeff, show (Finsupp.single () (y PUnit.unit)) = y by grind]

name: gaussNorm_pos
statement:
lemma gaussNorm_pos (hf : f ≠ 0) (vZero : v 0 = 0) (vNonneg : ∀ a, v a ≥ 0)
    (h_eq_zero : ∀ x : R, v x = 0 → x = 0) (hc : 0 < c) (hbd : HasGaussNorm v c f) :
    0 < gaussNorm v c f
proof:
:= by
  contrapose hf
  exact (gaussNorm_eq_zero_iff v c f vZero vNonneg h_eq_zero hc hbd).mp (le_antisymm (by grind)
    (gaussNorm_nonneg v c f vNonneg))

name: gaussNorm_neg
statement:
lemma gaussNorm_neg [Ring R] (vNeg : ∀ x, v (-x) = v x) :
    gaussNorm v c (-f) = gaussNorm v c f
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm_neg v (fun _ ↦ c) vNeg f

name: gaussNorm_mul_le
statement:
lemma gaussNorm_mul_le (f g : PowerSeries R) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (vNonneg : ∀ a, v a ≥ 0)
    (vMul : ∀ a b, v (a * b) ≤ v a * v b) (vUltra : ∀ a b, v (a + b) ≤ max (v a) (v b))
    (vZero : v 0 = 0) (hbfd : HasGaussNorm v c f) (hbgd : HasGaussNorm v c g) :
    gaussNorm v c (f * g) ≤ gaussNorm v c f * gaussNorm v c g
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm_mul_le v (fun _ ↦ c) f g (fun _ => by simp [hc]) vNonneg vMul vUltra vZero
    hbfd.hasMvGaussNorm hbgd.hasMvGaussNorm

name: achievesGaussNorm_iff
statement:
lemma achievesGaussNorm_iff (i : ℕ) : achievesGaussNorm v c f i ↔
    v (coeff i f) * c ^ i = gaussNorm v c f
proof:
:= by
  simp [achievesGaussNorm, MvPowerSeries.AchievesGaussNorm, PowerSeries.coeff]

name: exists_antidiagDom_iff_exists_mvAntidiagDom
statement:
lemma exists_antidiagDom_iff_exists_mvAntidiagDom (f g : PowerSeries R) :
    (∃ i j,
    achievesGaussNorm v c f i ∧ achievesGaussNorm v c g j ∧
    ∀ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal (i + j), p ≠ (i, j) →
    v (coeff p.1 f * coeff p.2 g) < v (coeff i f) * v (coeff j g)) ↔
    (∃ i j, MvPowerSeries.AchievesGaussNorm v (fun _ ↦ c) f i ∧
    MvPowerSeries.AchievesGaussNorm v (fun _ ↦ c) g j ∧∀ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal (i + j),
    p ≠ (i, j) → v ((MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1) f * (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2) g) <
    v ((MvPowerSeries.coeff i) f) * v ((MvPowerSeries.coeff j) g))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hdom
    obtain ⟨i, j, hi, hj, hdom'⟩ := hdom
    refine ⟨Finsupp.single () i, Finsupp.single () j, hi, hj,
      ?_⟩
    intro p hp _
    have hp1 : p.1 = Finsupp.single () (p.1 ()) := by grind
    have hp2 : p.2 = Finsupp.single () (p.2 ()) := by grind
    rw [hp1, hp2]
    exact hdom' (p.1 (), p.2 ()) (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr
      (by simpa using congrArg (· ()) (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp))) (by grind)
  · intro hdom
    obtain ⟨i, j, hi, hj, hdom'⟩ := hdom
    refine ⟨i PUnit.unit, j PUnit.unit, by simpa [achievesGaussNorm,
      show (Finsupp.single () (i PUnit.unit)) = i by grind],
      by simpa [achievesGaussNorm, show (Finsupp.single () (j PUnit.unit)) = j by grind], ?_⟩
    intro p hp _
    simpa [coeff, show (Finsupp.single () (i PUnit.unit)) = i by grind, show (Finsupp.single ()
      (j PUnit.unit)) = j by grind] using hdom' (Finsupp.single () p.1, (Finsupp.single () p.2))
      (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (by aesop)) (by grind)

name: gaussNorm_le_mul
statement:
lemma gaussNorm_le_mul (f g : PowerSeries R)
    (vMulEq : ∀ a b, v (a * b) = v a * v b) (vUltra : ∀ a b, v (a + b) ≤ max (v a) (v b))
    (vNeg : ∀ a, v a = v (-a)) (hbfg : HasGaussNorm v c (f * g))
    (hdom : ∃ i j, achievesGaussNorm v c f i ∧ achievesGaussNorm v c g j ∧
      ∀ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal (i + j), p ≠ (i, j) →
        v (coeff p.1 f * coeff p.2 g) < v (coeff i f) * v (coeff j g)) :
    gaussNorm v c f * gaussNorm v c g ≤ gaussNorm v c (f * g)
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm_le_mul v (fun _ ↦ c) f g vMulEq vUltra vNeg hbfg.hasMvGaussNorm
    ((exists_antidiagDom_iff_exists_mvAntidiagDom v c f g).mp hdom)

name: gaussNorm_mul_eq_mul
statement:
lemma gaussNorm_mul_eq_mul (f g : PowerSeries R)
    (hf : HasGaussNorm v c f) (hg : HasGaussNorm v c g) (hfg : HasGaussNorm v c (f * g))
    (vNonneg : ∀ a, v a ≥ 0) (vZero : v 0 = 0) (vNA : IsNonarchimedean v)
    (vMulEq : ∀ (a b : R), v (a * b) = v a * v b) (vNeg : ∀ (a : R), v (-a) = v a)
    (h_eq_zero : ∀ (x : R), v x = 0 → x = 0) (hc :  0 < c)
    (hdom : ∃ i j, achievesGaussNorm v c f i ∧ achievesGaussNorm v c g j ∧
      ∀ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal (i + j), p ≠ (i, j) → v (coeff p.1 f * coeff p.2 g) <
      v (coeff i f) * v (coeff j g)) :
    gaussNorm v c (f * g) = gaussNorm v c f * gaussNorm v c g
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm_mul_eq_mul v (fun _ ↦ c) f g hf.hasMvGaussNorm hg.hasMvGaussNorm
    hfg.hasMvGaussNorm vNonneg vZero vNA vMulEq vNeg h_eq_zero (by grind)
    ((exists_antidiagDom_iff_exists_mvAntidiagDom v c f g).mp hdom)

name: isRestricted_iff_cofinite
statement:
lemma isRestricted_iff_cofinite {f : PowerSeries R} :
    PowerSeries.IsRestricted c f ↔
      Filter.Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => ‖PowerSeries.coeff i f‖ * c ^ i)
        Filter.cofinite (nhds 0)
proof:

name: hasGaussNorm
statement:
lemma hasGaussNorm (f : PowerSeries.Restricted R c) :
    PowerSeries.HasGaussNorm norm c f.1
proof:
:=
  Filter.Tendsto.bddAbove_range_of_cofinite
    ((isRestricted_iff_cofinite c).mp f.2)

name: c_pos
statement: lemma c_pos : (0 : ℝ) < c
proof: := StrongPos_pos (fun _ : Unit ↦ c) ()

name: norm_eq
statement:
lemma norm_eq (f : PowerSeries.Restricted R c) :
    ‖f‖ = PowerSeries.gaussNorm (norm : R → ℝ) c f.1
proof: := rfl

name: isNonarchimedean
statement:
theorem isNonarchimedean :
    IsNonarchimedean (R := ℝ) (α := PowerSeries.Restricted R c) norm
proof:
:=
  fun f g => PowerSeries.gaussNorm_add_le_max norm c f.1 g.1 (c_pos c).le norm_nonneg
    IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max (hasGaussNorm c f) (hasGaussNorm c g)

name: map_injective
statement:
theorem map_injective (hf : Injective f) :
    Injective (map f : MvPowerSeries σ R → MvPowerSeries σ S)
proof:

proof:

  specialize h (a₁ := C r) (a₂ := C r')
  simp only [map_C, eq, forall_const] at h
  rw [← constantCoeff_C r, ← constantCoeff_C r', h]

name: map_surjective
statement:
theorem map_surjective (hf : Surjective f) :
    Surjective (map f : MvPowerSeries σ R → MvPowerSeries σ S)
proof:

  intro p; choose q _ using fun _ ↦ hf (coeff _ p)
  use q; simpa [MvPowerSeries.ext_iff]

name: map_surjective_iff

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, map_surjective⟩
  intro s; obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := h (C s)
  rw [MvPowerSeries.ext_iff] at hp
  use constantCoeff p; simpa using hp 0

name: coeff_sumToIterFun
statement:
private lemma coeff_sumToIterFun (x : σ →₀ ℕ) (y : τ →₀ ℕ) (p : MvPowerSeries (σ ⊕ τ) R) :
    coeff y (coeff x (sumToIterFun σ τ R p)) = coeff (x.sumElim y) p
proof: := rfl

name: sumToIterFun_monomial
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext y z
  simp only [coeff_sumToIterFun, coeff_monomial, Finsupp.ext_iff, coe_sumElim, Sum.forall,
    Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, comapDomain_apply]
  split_ifs
  · rw [coeff_monomial, if_pos (by ext; grind [comapDomain_apply])]
  · grind
  · rw [coeff_monomial, if_neg (by simp [Finsupp.ext_iff]; grind)]
  · simp

name: sumToIterFun_mul
statement:
private lemma sumToIterFun_mul (p q) : sumToIterFun σ τ R (p * q) =
    sumToIterFun σ τ R p * sumToIterFun σ τ R q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x y
  simp only [coeff_sumToIterFun, coeff_mul, map_sum, ← sum_product']
  rw [← image_sumElim_product_antidiagonal, sum_image
    (LeftInverse.injective (g := fun (x, y) ↦ ((x.comapDomain Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective.injOn,
    y.comapDomain Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective.injOn), x.comapDomain Sum.inr Sum.inr_injective.injOn,
    y.comapDomain Sum.inr Sum.inr_injective.injOn)) (fun _ ↦ by simp)).injOn]

      ((monomial (comapDomain Sum.inr x Sum.inr_injective.injOn)) r)

    coeff x ((sumAlgEquiv σ τ R).symm p) = coeff (comapDomain Sum.inr x Sum.inr_injective.injOn)
      (coeff (comapDomain Sum.inl x Sum.inl_injective.injOn) p)

name: sumAlgEquiv_comp_rename_inr
statement:
theorem sumAlgEquiv_comp_rename_inr : (sumAlgEquiv σ τ R).toAlgHom.comp
    (rename Embedding.inr) = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R (MvPowerSeries τ R)
      (MvPowerSeries σ (MvPowerSeries τ R))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext p x y
  simp only [AlgEquiv.toAlgHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_comp, AlgHom.coe_coe, comp_apply,
    IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom', algebraMap_apply,
    Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply, coeff_C]
  show (coeff y) ((coeff x) (sumToIter σ τ R ((rename ⇑Embedding.inr) p))) =
    (coeff y) (if x = 0 then p else 0)
  rw [coeff_sumToIter]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    rw [← Finsupp.embDomain_inr, coeff_embDomain_rename]
  · replace h : x.sumElim y ∉ Set.range (mapDomain Embedding.inr) := by
      rw [mem_range_mapDomain_iff _ (Embedding.injective _)]
      revert h; simp [Finsupp.ext_iff]
    rw [coeff_rename_eq_zero _ _ h, map_zero]

name: sumAlgEquiv_comp_rename_inl
statement:
theorem sumAlgEquiv_comp_rename_inl : (sumAlgEquiv σ τ R).toAlgHom.comp
    (rename Embedding.inl) = mapAlgHom (Algebra.ofId ..)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext p x y
  simp only [AlgEquiv.toAlgHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_comp, AlgHom.coe_coe, comp_apply,
    show (coeff x) ((mapAlgHom (Algebra.ofId R (MvPowerSeries τ R))) p) = C (coeff x p) from rfl]
  show (coeff y) ((coeff x) (sumToIter σ τ R ((rename ⇑Embedding.inl) p))) =
    (coeff y) (C ((coeff x) p))
  rw [coeff_sumToIter]
  by_cases h : y = 0
  · subst h
    rw [← Finsupp.embDomain_inl, coeff_embDomain_rename, coeff_C, if_pos rfl]
  · have : x.sumElim y ∉ Set.range (mapDomain Embedding.inl) := by
      rw [mem_range_mapDomain_iff _ (Embedding.injective _)]
      revert h; simp [Finsupp.ext_iff]
    rw [coeff_rename_eq_zero _ _ this, coeff_C, if_neg h]

name: commAlgEquiv_C
statement:
@[simp]
lemma commAlgEquiv_C (p : MvPowerSeries τ R) : commAlgEquiv σ τ R (C p) = map C p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext y x
  simp only [commAlgEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, renameEquiv_apply,
    AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.toRingHom_toMonoidHom,
    OneHom.toFun_eq_coe, MonoidHom.toOneHom_coe, MonoidHom.coe_coe, sumAlgEquiv_apply,
    coeff_sumToIter, coeff_map, coeff_C]
  by_cases h : y.sumElim x ∈ Set.range (mapDomain (Equiv.sumComm σ τ).toEmbedding)
  · rw [← funext_iff.mpr (embDomain_eq_mapDomain _)] at h
    rcases h with ⟨z, hz⟩
    simp_rw [← hz, ← Equiv.coe_toEmbedding, coeff_embDomain_rename, coeff_sumAlgEquiv_symm_apply]
    rw [embDomain_eq_mapDomain, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding, Equiv.sumComm_apply,
      ← mapDomain_swap_sumElim (M := ℕ), (mapDomain_injective
        Sum.swap_leftInverse.injective).eq_iff] at hz
    rw [hz, comapDomain_inr_sumElim, comapDomain_inl_sumElim, coeff_C]
    split <;> simp
  · simp_rw [← Equiv.coe_toEmbedding, coeff_rename_eq_zero _ _ h]
    rw [mem_range_mapDomain_iff _ (Embedding.injective _)] at h
    simp at h

statement:
@[simp]
lemma commAlgEquiv_X (i : σ) : commAlgEquiv σ τ R (X i) = C (X i)
proof:
:= by

name: embDomain_finSuccEquiv_cons
statement:
private lemma embDomain_finSuccEquiv_cons {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {n : ℕ} (i : M)
    (x : Fin n →₀ M) : embDomain (finSuccEquiv n).toEmbedding (cons i x) = optionElim i x
proof:
:= by
  ext a; cases a <;> simp [embDomain_eq_mapDomain]

name: image_optionElim_product_antidiagonal
statement:
private theorem image_optionElim_product_antidiagonal [DecidableEq σ]
    {x : σ →₀ ℕ} {n : ℕ} : image (fun ((x, y), z, w) ↦
      (z.optionElim x, w.optionElim y)) (antidiagonal n ×ˢ antidiagonal x) =
    antidiagonal (x.optionElim n)
proof:
:= by
  symm; ext ⟨u, v⟩
  simp only [mem_antidiagonal, mem_image, mem_product, Prod.mk.injEq, Prod.exists]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨u none, v none, u.some, v.some, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, by simp⟩,
    fun ⟨a, b, i, j, h1, h2, h3⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← Finsupp.add_apply, h, optionElim_apply_none]
  · rw [← some_add, h, some_optionElim]
  · rw [← h2, ← h3, ← optionElim_add, h1.left, h1.right]

name: coeff_coeff_optionFunLeft
statement:
private lemma coeff_coeff_optionFunLeft (p : MvPowerSeries (Option σ) R) (n : ℕ) (x : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff x (PowerSeries.coeff n (optionFunLeft σ R p)) = coeff (x.optionElim n) p
proof:
:= by
  calc coeff x (PowerSeries.coeff n (optionFunLeft σ R p))
      = coeff x ((fun x ↦ p.coeff (x.optionElim n) : MvPowerSeries σ R)) :=
        congrArg (coeff x) (PowerSeries.coeff_mk n _)
    _ = coeff (x.optionElim n) p := MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply _ _

name: optionFunLeft_monomial
statement:
private theorem optionFunLeft_monomial (x : Option σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    optionFunLeft σ R (monomial x r) = PowerSeries.monomial (x none) (monomial x.some r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext1 n; rw [PowerSeries.coeff_monomial]
  split_ifs with h
  · ext y; rw [h, coeff_coeff_optionFunLeft, coeff_monomial]
    split_ifs with h'
    · rw [← h']; simp
    refine (coeff_monomial_ne ?_ _).symm
    intro h''; simp [h''] at h'
  · ext y; rw [coeff_coeff_optionFunLeft, map_zero]
    exact coeff_monomial_ne (by simpa [Finsupp.ext_iff] using ⟨none, by simpa⟩) r

name: optionFunLeft_mul
statement:
private lemma optionFunLeft_mul (p q : MvPowerSeries (Option σ) R) :
    optionFunLeft σ R (p * q) = optionFunLeft σ R p * optionFunLeft σ R q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext
  simpa [coeff_coeff_optionFunLeft, coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul, map_sum, ← sum_product',
    ← image_optionElim_product_antidiagonal] using sum_image (LeftInverse.injective
      (g := fun (x, y) ↦ ((x none, y none), x.some, y.some)) (fun _ ↦ by simp)).injOn

name: coeff_optionInvFunLeft
statement:
lemma coeff_optionInvFunLeft (p : PowerSeries (MvPowerSeries σ R)) (x : Option σ →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff x (optionInvFunLeft σ R p) = (p.coeff (x none)).coeff x.some
proof: := rfl

name: coeff_coeff_optionEquivLeft
statement:
lemma coeff_coeff_optionEquivLeft (p : MvPowerSeries (Option σ) R) (n : ℕ) (x : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff x (PowerSeries.coeff n (optionEquivLeft σ R p)) = coeff (x.optionElim n) p
proof:
:=
  coeff_coeff_optionFunLeft ..

name: optionEquivLeft_monomial
statement:
theorem optionEquivLeft_monomial (x : Option σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    optionEquivLeft σ R (monomial x r) = PowerSeries.monomial (x none) (monomial x.some r)
proof:

  optionFunLeft_monomial ..

name: optionEquivLeft_X_some
statement:
@[simp]
lemma optionEquivLeft_X_some (i : σ) :
    optionEquivLeft σ R (X (Option.some i)) = (PowerSeries.C (X i))
proof:
:= by
  have : (optionElim 0 (single i 1)) = single (Option.some i) 1 := by
    classical
    ext a; cases a <;> simp [single_apply]
  simpa [← X_def, PowerSeries.monomial_eq_C_mul_X_pow, this] using
    optionEquivLeft_monomial (single (Option.some i) 1 : Option σ →₀ ℕ) (1 : R)

name: optionEquivLeft_X_none
statement:
@[simp]
lemma optionEquivLeft_X_none : optionEquivLeft σ R (X none) = PowerSeries.X
proof:
:= by
  simpa [PowerSeries.monomial_eq_C_mul_X_pow, ← X_def] using
    optionEquivLeft_monomial (single none 1 : Option σ →₀ ℕ) (1 : R)

name: optionEquivLeft_C
statement:
@[simp]
lemma optionEquivLeft_C (r : R) : (optionEquivLeft σ R) (C r) = PowerSeries.C (C r)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using optionEquivLeft_monomial (0 : Option σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R)

name: coeff_coeff_optionFunRight
statement:
private theorem coeff_coeff_optionFunRight (p : MvPowerSeries (Option σ) R) (x : σ →₀ ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((optionFunRight σ R p).coeff x).coeff n = p.coeff (x.optionElim n)
proof:
:= by
  simp [PowerSeries.coeff, coeff, LinearMap.proj, optionFunRight, PowerSeries.mk]

name: optionFunRight_monomial
statement:
private theorem optionFunRight_monomial (x : Option σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    optionFunRight σ R (monomial x r) = monomial x.some (PowerSeries.monomial (x none) r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext y n
  rw [coeff_coeff_optionFunRight, coeff_monomial, coeff_monomial]
  split_ifs with h h' h''
  · rw [PowerSeries.coeff_monomial, eq_comm, ite_eq_left_iff]
    suffices h : n = x none by simp [h]
    simpa using DFunLike.congr_fun h none
  · exfalso; revert h'; rw [imp_false, not_not]
    ext i; rw [← optionElim_apply_some n, h, some_apply]
  · rw [PowerSeries.coeff_monomial, eq_comm, ite_eq_right_iff]
    intro h'; exfalso; revert h
    simp [h', h'']
  · simp

name: optionFunRight_mul
statement:
private lemma optionFunRight_mul (p q : MvPowerSeries (Option σ) R) :
    optionFunRight σ R (p * q) = optionFunRight σ R p * optionFunRight σ R q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext
  simpa [coeff_coeff_optionFunRight, coeff_mul, ← image_optionElim_product_antidiagonal,
    map_sum, PowerSeries.coeff_mul, ← sum_product_right'] using sum_image (LeftInverse.injective
      (g := fun (x, y) ↦ ((x none, y none), x.some, y.some)) (fun _ ↦ by simp)).injOn

name: coeff_optionInvFunRight
statement:
lemma coeff_optionInvFunRight (p : MvPowerSeries σ (PowerSeries R)) (x : Option σ →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff x (optionInvFunRight σ R p) = (p.coeff x.some).coeff (x none)
proof: := rfl

name: coeff_coeff_optionEquivRight
statement:
theorem coeff_coeff_optionEquivRight (p : MvPowerSeries (Option σ) R) (x : σ →₀ ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((optionEquivRight σ R p).coeff x).coeff n = p.coeff (x.optionElim n)
proof:
:=
  coeff_coeff_optionFunRight p x n

name: optionEquivRight_monomial
statement:
theorem optionEquivRight_monomial (x : Option σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    optionEquivRight σ R (monomial x r) = monomial x.some (PowerSeries.monomial (x none) r)
proof:
:=
  optionFunRight_monomial x r

name: optionEquivRight_X_some
statement: lemma optionEquivRight_X_some (i : σ) : optionEquivRight σ R (X (some i)) = X i
proof:
:= by
  simpa [← X_def] using optionEquivRight_monomial (single (some i) 1) (1 : R)

name: optionEquivRight_X_none
statement: lemma optionEquivRight_X_none : optionEquivRight σ R (X none) = C PowerSeries.X
proof:

name: optionEquivRight_C

name: coeff_coeff_finSuccEquiv
statement:
theorem coeff_coeff_finSuccEquiv (p : MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) R) {k x} :
    coeff x (PowerSeries.coeff k (finSuccEquiv R n p)) = coeff (x.cons k) p
proof:
:= by
  suffices (coeff x) ((PowerSeries.coeff k) ((optionEquivLeft (Fin n) R)
    ((rename (_root_.finSuccEquiv n)) p))) = (coeff (Finsupp.cons k x)) p by simpa [finSuccEquiv]
  simp_rw [← Equiv.coe_toEmbedding, coeff_coeff_optionEquivLeft,
    ← embDomain_finSuccEquiv_cons, coeff_embDomain_rename]

name: finSuccEquiv_X_zero
statement: theorem finSuccEquiv_X_zero : finSuccEquiv R n (X 0) = .X
proof:
:= by
  ext k x
  rw [coeff_coeff_finSuccEquiv, PowerSeries.coeff_X, coeff_X]
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h3
  · rw [cons_eq_single_zero_iff] at h1
    simp [h1.left]
  · grind [cons_eq_single_zero_iff]
  · rw [cons_eq_single_zero_iff, not_and'] at h1
    rw [coeff_one, if_neg (h1 h3)]
  · rw [coeff_zero]

name: finSuccEquiv_X_succ
statement: theorem finSuccEquiv_X_succ {j : Fin n} : finSuccEquiv R n (X j.succ) = .C (X j)
proof:
:= by
  ext k x
  rw [coeff_coeff_finSuccEquiv, PowerSeries.coeff_C, coeff_X]
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h3
  · rw [cons_eq_single_succ_iff] at h1
    simp [h1.left]
  · grind [cons_eq_single_succ_iff]
  · rw [cons_eq_single_succ_iff, not_and'] at h1
    rw [coeff_X, if_neg (h1 h3)]
  · rw [coeff_zero]

name: finSuccEquiv_comp_C
statement:
theorem finSuccEquiv_comp_C : (MvPowerSeries.finSuccEquiv R n).symm.toRingHom.comp
    (PowerSeries.C.comp MvPowerSeries.C) = MvPowerSeries.C
proof:
:= RingHom.ext fun r ↦ by
  classical
  rw [AlgEquiv.symm_toRingEquiv, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_comp,
    RingHom.coe_coe, comp_apply, RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  ext; simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, comp_apply, PowerSeries.coeff_C,
    AlgEquiv.coe_ringEquiv, coeff_coeff_finSuccEquiv, coeff_C]
  rw [← single_zero 0]
  grind [coeff_C, cons_eq_single_zero_iff]

name: finSuccEquiv_renameEquiv_finSuccEquiv
statement:
lemma finSuccEquiv_renameEquiv_finSuccEquiv (e : σ ≃ Fin n) (p) :
    (renameEquiv R ((Equiv.optionCongr e).trans (_root_.finSuccEquiv n).symm)).trans
      (finSuccEquiv R n) p = PowerSeries.map (rename e).toRingHom
        (optionEquivLeft σ R p)
proof:
:= by
  ext k x
  simp only [AlgEquiv.trans_apply, renameEquiv_apply, Equiv.coe_trans, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe,
    RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.toRingHom_toMonoidHom, OneHom.toFun_eq_coe,
    MonoidHom.toOneHom_coe, MonoidHom.coe_coe, PowerSeries.coeff_map, RingHom.coe_coe]
  have aux : x.cons k = embDomain (e.optionCongr.toEmbedding.trans
    (_root_.finSuccEquiv n).symm.toEmbedding) ((x.mapDomain e.symm).optionElim k) := by
    rw [embDomain_eq_mapDomain, ← Equiv.trans_toEmbedding, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding,
      ← equivMapDomain_eq_mapDomain, ← equivCongrLeft_apply, eq_comm,
      Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq_symm_apply]
    ext a; cases a <;> simp
  have aux' : x = embDomain e.toEmbedding (x.mapDomain e.symm) := by
    rw [embDomain_eq_mapDomain, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding, ← mapDomain_comp,
      Equiv.self_comp_symm, mapDomain_id]
  simp_rw [coeff_coeff_finSuccEquiv, aux, ← Equiv.coe_toEmbedding, ← Embedding.coe_trans,
    ← Equiv.trans_toEmbedding, coeff_embDomain_rename]
  nth_rw 2 [aux']
  rw [coeff_embDomain_rename, ← coeff_coeff_optionEquivLeft, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding]

name: truncTotal_sub_truncTotal_mem_pow_idealOfVars
statement:
lemma truncTotal_sub_truncTotal_mem_pow_idealOfVars {l m n : ℕ} (h : l ≤ m) (h' : l ≤ n)
    (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) : p.truncTotal m - p.truncTotal n ∈
      MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ l
proof:
:= by
  refine (MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff' ..).mpr (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sub, sub_eq_zero, coeff_truncTotal _ (by lia),
    coeff_truncTotal _ (by lia)]

name: truncTotal_mul_sub_mul_truncTotal_mem_pow_idealOfVars
statement:
lemma truncTotal_mul_sub_mul_truncTotal_mem_pow_idealOfVars (p q : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (p * q).truncTotal n - p.truncTotal n * q.truncTotal n ∈
      MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ n
proof:
:= by
  refine (MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff' ..).mpr (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sub, sub_eq_zero, coeff_truncTotal _ hx,
    coeff_truncTotal_mul_truncTotal_eq_coeff_mul _ _ hx]

name: toAdicCompletion_apply_eq_mk_truncTotal
statement:
lemma toAdicCompletion_apply_eq_mk_truncTotal {n : ℕ} {p : MvPowerSeries σ R} :
    (toAdicCompletion σ R p).val n = truncTotal n p
proof: := by rfl

name: coeff_toAdicCompletion_val_apply_out
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_truncTotal _ hx, ← sub_eq_zero, ← MvPolynomial.coeff_sub]
  apply (MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff' n _).mp
  · rw [toAdicCompletion_apply_eq_mk_truncTotal, smul_eq_mul]
    nth_rw 1 [← Ideal.mul_top (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ n), ← Ideal.Quotient.eq,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_out]
  exact hx

name: toAdicCompletion_coe
statement:
theorem toAdicCompletion_coe (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    toAdicCompletion σ R p = .of (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R) (MvPolynomial σ R) p
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [toAdicCompletion_apply_eq_mk_truncTotal, AdicCompletion.of_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Submodule.mkQ_apply]
  have h : (truncTotal n) (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) - p ∈
      MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ n * ⊤ := by
    rw [Ideal.mul_top]
    refine (MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff' ..).mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_
    simp [coeff_truncTotal _ hx]
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).mpr h

name: coeff_toAdicCompletionInv
proof: := by rfl

name: mk_truncTotal_toAdicCompletionInv
statement:
theorem mk_truncTotal_toAdicCompletionInv {n : ℕ}
    {f : AdicCompletion (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R) (MvPolynomial σ R)} :
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ n • ⊤)
    ((truncTotal n) (toAdicCompletionInv σ R f)) = f.val n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.mk_out (f.val n), Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk_iff_sub_mem]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top, MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff',
    MvPolynomial.coeff_sub]
  intro x h
  rw [coeff_truncTotal _ h, coeff_toAdicCompletionInv, ← MvPolynomial.coeff_sub]
  apply (MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff' (degree x + 1) _).mp
  · nth_rw 1 [← Ideal.mul_top (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ (degree x + 1)),
      ← smul_eq_mul, ← Ideal.Quotient.eq]
    simp only [Submodule.mapQ_eq_factor, Submodule.factor_eq_factor, Ideal.Quotient.mk_out]
    rw [← AdicCompletion.transitionMap_ideal_mk _ (Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le.mp h), eq_comm]
    convert f.prop h; simp
  simp

name: toAdicCompletionAlgEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toAdicCompletionAlgEquiv_apply (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    toAdicCompletionAlgEquiv σ R p = toAdicCompletion σ R p

name: toAdicCompletionAlgEquiv_symm_apply

name: isRestrictedGauss_abs_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isRestrictedGauss_abs_iff (c : σ → ℝ) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    IsRestrictedGauss |c| f ↔ IsRestrictedGauss c f
proof:
:= by
  simp [IsRestrictedGauss, NormedAddGroup.tendsto_nhds_zero, Finsupp.prod]

name: isRestrictedGauss_zero
statement: lemma isRestrictedGauss_zero (c : σ → ℝ) : IsRestrictedGauss c (0 : MvPowerSeries σ R)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [IsRestrictedGauss] using tendsto_const_nhds

name: isRestrictedGauss_monomial
statement:
lemma isRestrictedGauss_monomial (c : σ → ℝ) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R) :
    IsRestrictedGauss c (monomial n a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_eq (Set.Subsingleton.finite ?_)
  aesop (add simp [Set.Subsingleton, coeff_monomial])

name: isRestrictedGauss_one
statement: lemma isRestrictedGauss_one (c : σ → ℝ) : IsRestrictedGauss c (1 : MvPowerSeries σ R)

name: isRestrictedGauss_C
statement: lemma isRestrictedGauss_C (c : σ → ℝ) (a : R) : IsRestrictedGauss c (C a)

name: isRestrictedGauss.add
statement:
lemma isRestrictedGauss.add (c : σ → ℝ) {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R} (hf : IsRestrictedGauss c f)
    (hg : IsRestrictedGauss c g) : IsRestrictedGauss c (f + g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isRestrictedGauss_abs_iff, IsRestrictedGauss] at *
  refine tendsto_const_nhds.squeeze (add_zero (0 : ℝ) ▸ hf.add hg) (fun n ↦ ?_) fun n ↦ ?_
  · dsimp [Finsupp.prod]; positivity 
  rw [← add_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_add_le ..) (by dsimp [Finsupp.prod]; positivity)

statement:
lemma isRestrictedGauss.neg (c : σ → ℝ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} (hf : IsRestrictedGauss c f) :
    IsRestrictedGauss c (-f)

:= by
  rw [← isRestrictedGauss_abs_iff, IsRestrictedGauss] at *
  simpa [IsRestrictedGauss] using hf

name: tendsto_sup'_antidiagonal_cofinite
statement:
lemma tendsto_sup'_antidiagonal_cofinite
    {M R : Type*} [AddMonoid M] [Finset.HasAntidiagonal M] {f : M × M → R}
    [LinearOrder R] {F : Filter R} (hf : Tendsto f cofinite F) :
    Tendsto (fun a ↦ (Finset.antidiagonal a).sup' (Finset.nonempty_antidiagonal _) f)
      cofinite F
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  refine ((((hf hU).image Prod.fst)).add ((hf hU).image Prod.snd)).subset ?_
  simp only [Set.subset_def, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi, e⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' (Finset.nonempty_antidiagonal x) f
  obtain rfl : i.1 + i.2 = x := by simpa using hi
  exact Set.add_mem_add (by simpa using ⟨i.2, e ▸ hx⟩) (by simpa using ⟨i.1, e ▸ hx⟩)

name: tendsto_antidiagonal
statement:
lemma tendsto_antidiagonal {M S : Type*} [AddMonoid M] [Finset.HasAntidiagonal M] [NormedRing S]
    [IsUltrametricDist S] {C : M → ℝ} (hC : ∀ a b, C (a + b) = C a * C b) {f g : M → S}
    (hf : Tendsto (fun i ↦ ‖f i‖ * C i) cofinite (𝓝 0))
    (hg : Tendsto (fun i ↦ ‖g i‖ * C i) cofinite (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun a ↦ ‖∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal a, (f p.1 * g p.2)‖ * C a) cofinite (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  wlog hC' : 0 ≤ C generalizing C
  · rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
    simpa using this (C := |C|) (by simp [hC]) (by simpa using hf.norm)
      (by simpa using hg.norm) (fun _ => by simp)
  refine .squeeze tendsto_const_nhds
    (tendsto_sup'_antidiagonal_cofinite (tendsto_mul_cofinite_nhds_zero hf hg))
    (fun x => by simpa using (mul_nonneg (by simp) (hC' x))) fun a ↦ ?_
  have : 0 ≤ C a := hC' a
  grw [(Finset.nonempty_antidiagonal _).norm_sum_le_sup'_norm, Finset.sup'_mul₀ this]
  refine Finset.sup'_mono_fun fun x hx ↦ ?_
  grw [mul_mul_mul_comm, ← hC, Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hx, ← norm_mul_le]

name: isRestrictedGauss.mul
statement:
lemma isRestrictedGauss.mul [IsUltrametricDist R] (c : σ → ℝ) {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R}
    (hf : IsRestrictedGauss c f) (hg : IsRestrictedGauss c g) : IsRestrictedGauss c (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← isRestrictedGauss_abs_iff, IsRestrictedGauss] at *
  exact tendsto_antidiagonal (by simp [Finsupp.prod_add_index', pow_add]) hf hg

name: exists_map_finset_prod_le_of_nonempty
statement:
lemma exists_map_finset_prod_le_of_nonempty {α S : Type*} [Semiring S] [LinearOrder S]
    [AddCommMonoid α] (g : α → S) {ι : Type*} {t : Finset ι} (ht : t.Nonempty) (f : ι → α)
    (Ultra : ∀ a b, g (a + b) ≤ max (g a) (g b)) : ∃ i ∈ t, g (∑ j ∈ t, f j) ≤ g (f i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Finset.le_sup'_iff] using Finset.Nonempty.map_sum_le_sup'_map g ht f Ultra

name: exists_map_multiset_prod_le
statement:
lemma exists_map_multiset_prod_le {α S : Type*} [Semiring S] [LinearOrder S]
    [AddCommMonoid α] (g : α → S) {ι : Type*} (Zero : g 0 = 0) (Nonneg : ∀ a, g a ≥ 0)
    (Ultra : ∀ a b, g (a + b) ≤ max (g a) (g b)) (t : Finset ι) [Nonempty ι]
    (f : ι → α) : ∃ i, (t.Nonempty → i ∈ t) ∧ g (∑ j ∈ t, f j) ≤ g (f i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases t.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ht
  · simp [Zero, Nonneg]
  · exact (fun ⟨i, h, h'⟩ => ⟨i, fun _ ↦ h, h'⟩) <|
      exists_map_finset_prod_le_of_nonempty g ht f Ultra

name: apply_sum_eq_of_lt
statement:
lemma apply_sum_eq_of_lt {α β S : Type*} [Semiring S] [LinearOrder S]
    [AddCommGroup α] (f : α → S) (Ultra : ∀ a b, f (a + b) ≤ max (f a) (f b)) {s : Finset β}
    {l : β → α} (Neg : ∀ a, f a = f (-a)) {k : β} (hk : k ∈ s)
    (hmax : ∀ j ∈ s, j ≠ k → f (l j) < f (l k)) :
    f (∑ i ∈ s, l i) = f (l k)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hcard : s.card = 1
  · grind [Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard]
  · classical
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hk]
    have hNonempty : (s.erase k).Nonempty :=
      Finset.Nontrivial.erase_nonempty (Finset.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp (by grind))
    have hrest_le := (Finset.Nonempty.map_sum_le_sup'_map f hNonempty l Ultra)
    simp only [Finset.le_sup'_iff, Finset.mem_erase, ne_eq] at hrest_le
    rw [ultrametric_strict f Ultra Neg (by grind), max_eq_left (le_of_lt (by grind))]

name: foo
statement: private lemma foo (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) (t : σ →₀ ℕ) : 0 ≤ t.prod (c · ^ ·)
proof:
:=
  Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ pow_nonneg (hc i) (t i))

name: gaussNorm_achieved
statement:
lemma gaussNorm_achieved [NormedRing R] [IsUltrametricDist R] (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (f : MvPowerSeries.Restricted R c) :
    ∃ a, MvPowerSeries.AchievesGaussNorm norm c f.1 a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [MvPowerSeries.AchievesGaussNorm]
  by_cases hG : gaussNorm R c f = 0
  · use 0
    have := MvPowerSeries.le_gaussNorm norm c f.1 (hasGaussNorm c f) 0
    simp only [hG] at this ⊢
    exact le_antisymm this (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (foo c hc 0))
  · have hpos : 0 < gaussNorm R c f :=
      (MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm_nonneg norm c f.1 norm_nonneg).lt_of_ne' hG
    have hfin : {t | gaussNorm R c f / 2 ≤ ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff t f.1‖ * t.prod (c · ^ ·)}.Finite := by
      have : MvPowerSeries.IsRestrictedGauss c f.1 := f.2
      simp_rw [MvPowerSeries.IsRestrictedGauss, NormedAddGroup.tendsto_nhds_zero] at this
      have := this (gaussNorm R c f / 2) (by aesop)
      simp only [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Filter.eventually_cofinite, not_lt, abs_norm] at this
      have habs : ∀ t : σ →₀ ℕ, |t.prod (c · ^ ·)| = t.prod (c · ^ ·) :=
        fun t => abs_of_nonneg (foo c hc t)
      simp only [habs] at this
      exact this
    have hne : {t | gaussNorm R c f / 2 ≤ ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff t f.1‖ * t.prod (c · ^ ·)}.Nonempty := by
      by_contra hemp
      rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hemp
      have hlt : gaussNorm R c f ≤ gaussNorm R c f / 2 := by
        apply ciSup_le
        intro t
        have : t ∉ {t | gaussNorm R c f / 2 ≤ ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff t f.1‖ * t.prod (c · ^ ·)} := by
          simp [hemp]
        grind
      linarith
    obtain ⟨m, hm_mem, hm_max⟩ := hfin.toFinset.exists_max_image
      (fun t ↦ ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff t f.1‖ * t.prod (c · ^ ·)) (by aesop)
    use m
    apply le_antisymm (MvPowerSeries.le_gaussNorm norm c f.1 (hasGaussNorm c f) m)
    apply ciSup_le
    intro t
    by_cases ht : t ∈ {t | gaussNorm R c f / 2 ≤ ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff t f.1‖ * t.prod (c · ^ ·)}
    · exact hm_max t (by aesop)
    · exact le_trans (le_of_lt (by aesop)) (by aesop)

name: achievingPoints_finite
statement:
lemma achievingPoints_finite [NormedRing R] [IsUltrametricDist R] (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (f : MvPowerSeries.Restricted R c) (h : gaussNorm R c f ≠ 0) :
    {a | MvPowerSeries.AchievesGaussNorm norm c f.1 a}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [MvPowerSeries.AchievesGaussNorm]
  have hpos : 0 < gaussNorm R c f :=
      (MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm_nonneg norm c f.1 norm_nonneg).lt_of_ne' h
  have hfin : {t | gaussNorm R c f / 2 ≤ ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff t f.1‖ * t.prod (c · ^ ·)}.Finite := by
      have : MvPowerSeries.IsRestrictedGauss c f.1 := f.2
      simp_rw [MvPowerSeries.IsRestrictedGauss, NormedAddGroup.tendsto_nhds_zero] at this
      have := this (gaussNorm R c f / 2) (by aesop)
      simp only [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Filter.eventually_cofinite, not_lt, abs_norm] at this
      have habs : ∀ t : σ →₀ ℕ, |t.prod (c · ^ ·)| = t.prod (c · ^ ·) :=
        fun t => abs_of_nonneg (foo c hc t)
      simp only [habs] at this
      exact this
  refine Set.Finite.subset hfin ?_
  grind

name: test
statement: lemma test (hc : ∀ (i : σ), 0 < c i) : 0 ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  exact Std.le_of_lt (hc i)

name: exists_lex_max_achieving
statement:
private lemma exists_lex_max_achieving [NormedRing R] [IsUltrametricDist R] [LinearOrder σ]
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (f : MvPowerSeries.Restricted R c) (hf : gaussNorm R c f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ i, MvPowerSeries.AchievesGaussNorm norm c f.1 i ∧
      ∀ a, MvPowerSeries.AchievesGaussNorm norm c f.1 a → toLex a ≤ toLex i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfin := achievingPoints_finite c hc f hf
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := gaussNorm_achieved c hc f
  obtain ⟨i, hiF, hiMax⟩ := hfin.toFinset.exists_max_image (fun a => toLex a)
    ⟨a₀, hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr ha₀⟩
  exact ⟨i, hfin.mem_toFinset.mp hiF, fun a ha => hiMax a (hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr ha)⟩

name: bar
statement:
lemma bar [NormedRing R] [IsUltrametricDist R] [LinearOrder σ] (hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i)
    (f g : MvPowerSeries.Restricted R c) (hf : gaussNorm R c f ≠ 0) (hg : gaussNorm R c g ≠ 0) :
    ∃ i j, MvPowerSeries.AchievesGaussNorm norm c f.1 i ∧
      MvPowerSeries.AchievesGaussNorm norm c g.1 j ∧
      ∀ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal (i + j), p ≠ (i, j) →
      norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 f.1 * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 g.1) <
      norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff i f.1) * norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff j g.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc' : (0 : σ → ℝ) ≤ c := fun i => (hc i).le
  have hfpos : 0 < gaussNorm R c f :=
    (MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm_nonneg norm c f.1 norm_nonneg).lt_of_ne' hf
  have hgpos : 0 < gaussNorm R c g :=
    (MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm_nonneg norm c g.1 norm_nonneg).lt_of_ne' hg
  have hw : ∀ t : σ →₀ ℕ, (0 : ℝ) < t.prod (c · ^ ·) :=
    fun t => Finset.prod_pos fun k _ => pow_pos (hc k) _
  obtain ⟨i, hiA, hiMax⟩ := exists_lex_max_achieving c hc' f hf
  obtain ⟨j, hjA, hjMax⟩ := exists_lex_max_achieving c hc' g hg
  refine ⟨i, j, hiA, hjA, fun p hp hne => ?_⟩
  rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
  
  have hcase : toLex i < toLex p.1 ∨ toLex j < toLex p.2 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hcon
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h1 with h1' | h1'
    · have hstrict : toLex (p.1 + p.2) < toLex (i + j) := by
        have := add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le h1' h2
        exact this
      rw [hp] at hstrict
      exact lt_irrefl _ hstrict
    · have hp1 : p.1 = i := by
        have := h1'
        exact toLex.injective this
      have hp2 : p.2 = j := by
        rw [hp1] at hp
        exact add_left_cancel hp
      exact hne (Prod.ext hp1 hp2)
  
  have hww : (p.1).prod (c · ^ ·) * (p.2).prod (c · ^ ·) =
      i.prod (c · ^ ·) * j.prod (c · ^ ·) := by
    rw [← Finsupp.prod_add_index' (fun a => pow_zero (c a)) (fun a m n => pow_add (c a) m n),
      ← Finsupp.prod_add_index' (fun a => pow_zero (c a)) (fun a m n => pow_add (c a) m n), hp]
  
  have hweighted :
      (norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 f.1) * (p.1).prod (c · ^ ·)) *
        (norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 g.1) * (p.2).prod (c · ^ ·)) <
      gaussNorm R c f * gaussNorm R c g := by
    rcases hcase with hgt | hgt
    · have hp1_not : ¬ MvPowerSeries.AchievesGaussNorm norm c f.1 p.1 :=
        fun hach => absurd (hiMax p.1 hach) (not_le.mpr hgt)
      have hf_lt : norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 f.1) * (p.1).prod (c · ^ ·) <
          gaussNorm R c f :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (MvPowerSeries.le_gaussNorm norm c f.1 (hasGaussNorm c f) p.1) hp1_not
      have hg_le : norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 g.1) * (p.2).prod (c · ^ ·) ≤
          gaussNorm R c g :=
        MvPowerSeries.le_gaussNorm norm c g.1 (hasGaussNorm c g) p.2
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 g.1))
          (hw p.2).le) with h0 | hpos
      · rw [← h0, mul_zero]
        exact mul_pos hfpos hgpos
      · exact mul_lt_mul hf_lt hg_le hpos hfpos.le
    · have hp2_not : ¬ MvPowerSeries.AchievesGaussNorm norm c g.1 p.2 :=
        fun hach => absurd (hjMax p.2 hach) (not_le.mpr hgt)
      have hg_lt : norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 g.1) * (p.2).prod (c · ^ ·) <
          gaussNorm R c g :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (MvPowerSeries.le_gaussNorm norm c g.1 (hasGaussNorm c g) p.2) hp2_not
      have hf_le : norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 f.1) * (p.1).prod (c · ^ ·) ≤
          gaussNorm R c f :=
        MvPowerSeries.le_gaussNorm norm c f.1 (hasGaussNorm c f) p.1
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 f.1))
          (hw p.1).le) with h0 | hpos
      · rw [← h0, zero_mul]
        exact mul_pos hfpos hgpos
      · calc (norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 f.1) * (p.1).prod (c · ^ ·)) *
              (norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 g.1) * (p.2).prod (c · ^ ·))
            = (norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 g.1) * (p.2).prod (c · ^ ·)) *
              (norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 f.1) * (p.1).prod (c · ^ ·)) := by ring
          _ < gaussNorm R c g * gaussNorm R c f :=
              mul_lt_mul hg_lt hf_le hpos hgpos.le
          _ = gaussNorm R c f * gaussNorm R c g := by ring
  
  have hGf : gaussNorm R c f = norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff i f.1) * i.prod (c · ^ ·) := hiA.symm
  have hGg : gaussNorm R c g = norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff j g.1) * j.prod (c · ^ ·) := hjA.symm
  rw [hGf, hGg] at hweighted
  have hkey : norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 f.1) * norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 g.1) <
      norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff i f.1) * norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff j g.1) := by
    have hwpos : (0 : ℝ) < i.prod (c · ^ ·) * j.prod (c · ^ ·) :=
      mul_pos (hw i) (hw j)
    refine lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right ?_ hwpos.le
    calc norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 f.1) * norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 g.1) *
          (i.prod (c · ^ ·) * j.prod (c · ^ ·))
        = norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 f.1) * norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 g.1) *
          ((p.1).prod (c · ^ ·) * (p.2).prod (c · ^ ·)) := by rw [hww]
      _ = (norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 f.1) * (p.1).prod (c · ^ ·)) *
          (norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 g.1) * (p.2).prod (c · ^ ·)) := by ring
      _ < (norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff i f.1) * i.prod (c · ^ ·)) *
          (norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff j g.1) * j.prod (c · ^ ·)) := hweighted
      _ = norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff i f.1) * norm (MvPowerSeries.coeff j g.1) *
          (i.prod (c · ^ ·) * j.prod (c · ^ ·)) := by ring
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_mul_le _ _) hkey

name: MvPolynomial.IsRestrictedGauss
statement:
lemma MvPolynomial.IsRestrictedGauss [NormedCommRing R] [IsUltrametricDist R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    MvPowerSeries.IsRestrictedGauss c f.toMvPowerSeries
proof:
:= by
  suffices {t | ¬ (‖(MvPowerSeries.coeff t) f.toMvPowerSeries‖ * t.prod (c · ^ ·) = 0)}.Finite by
    exact tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_eq this
  simp only [coeff_coe, mul_eq_zero, norm_eq_zero, not_or, ← mem_support_iff]
  exact Set.Finite.sep (Finset.finite_toSet _) _

name: comap_vle
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_vle (φ : A →+* B) (v : ValuativeRel B) (a₁ a₂ : A) :
    (comap φ v).vle a₁ a₂ = v.vle (φ a₁) (φ a₂)
proof: := rfl

name: not_vle_zero_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem not_vle_zero_of_isUnit [ValuativeRel A] {f : A} (hu : IsUnit f) :
    ¬ f ≤ᵥ (0 : A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hu
  intro h
  have := mul_vle_mul_right h (↑u⁻¹ : A)
  rw [Units.inv_mul, mul_zero] at this
  exact absurd this (not_vle.mpr zero_vlt_one)

name: glue_unique
statement:
theorem glue_unique {b : S.B} {c : S.C} {r r' : S.R}
    (hr : S.jB r = b ∧ S.iC r = c) (hr' : S.jB r' = b ∧ S.iC r' = c) : r = r'
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : S.jB (r - r') = 0 := by rw [map_sub, hr.1, hr'.1, sub_self]
  have h2 : S.iC (r - r') = 0 := by rw [map_sub, hr.2, hr'.2, sub_self]
  have := S.pair_injective _ h1 h2
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp this

name: gaussToTate_continuous
statement:
theorem gaussToTate_continuous :
    @Continuous (StrictLoc.PA K n) ↥(restrictedMvPowerSeriesSubring n (JetA K)) _
      (mvTateAlgebraTopology' (A := JetA K) n)
      ⇑(UnitDiscExample.restrictedGaussEquiv (JetA K) n)
proof:
:= by
  let _i := mvTateAlgebraTopology' (A := JetA K) n
  have := mvTateAlgebraTopology'_isTopologicalRing (A := JetA K) n
  set P := IsTateRing.principalPair (JetA K) with hPdef
  refine continuous_of_continuousAt_zero
    (UnitDiscExample.restrictedGaussEquiv (JetA K) n).toRingHom.toAddMonoidHom ?_
  rw [ContinuousAt, map_zero]
  refine ((mvTateAlgBasis' (A := JetA K) n).hasBasis_nhds_zero.tendsto_right_iff).mpr ?_
  intro j _
  have hIj : (Subtype.val ''
      ((P.toPairOfDefinition.I ^ j : Ideal P.toPairOfDefinition.A₀) :
        Set P.toPairOfDefinition.A₀)) ∈ nhds (0 : JetA K) :=
    P.toPairOfDefinition.hasBasis_nhds_zero.mem_of_mem trivial
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hIj
  have hcoeff : ∀ f : StrictLoc.PA K n, ‖f‖ < δ →
      ∀ l : Fin n →₀ ℕ, ∃ b : P.toPairOfDefinition.A₀,
      b ∈ P.toPairOfDefinition.I ^ j ∧ (b : JetA K) =
        MvPowerSeries.coeff l
          ((UnitDiscExample.restrictedGaussEquiv (JetA K) n) f).val := by
    intro f hf l
    have hmem : MvPowerSeries.coeff l f.1 ∈
        Subtype.val '' ((P.toPairOfDefinition.I ^ j :
          Ideal P.toPairOfDefinition.A₀) : Set P.toPairOfDefinition.A₀) := by
      refine hball ?_
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_coeff_le_gauss f l) hf
    obtain ⟨b, hbI, hbeq⟩ := hmem
    exact ⟨b, hbI, hbeq⟩
  refine Filter.eventually_iff_exists_mem.mpr
    ⟨Metric.ball 0 δ, Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ hδ, fun f hf => ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hf
  refine mvTateAlgNhd_of_coeff_mem_principal n P.toPairOfDefinition j
    P.π P.I_eq_span P.π_isUnit ?_ (hcoeff f hf)
  intro l
  obtain ⟨b, -, hbeq⟩ := hcoeff f hf l
  show MvPowerSeries.coeff l
    ((UnitDiscExample.restrictedGaussEquiv (JetA K) n) f).val ∈
      P.toPairOfDefinition.A₀
  rw [← hbeq]
  exact b.2

name: tateToGauss_continuous
statement:
theorem tateToGauss_continuous :
    @Continuous ↥(restrictedMvPowerSeriesSubring n (JetA K)) (StrictLoc.PA K n)
      (mvTateAlgebraTopology' (A := JetA K) n) _
      ⇑(UnitDiscExample.restrictedGaussEquiv (JetA K) n).symm
proof:
:= by
  let _i := mvTateAlgebraTopology' (A := JetA K) n
  have := mvTateAlgebraTopology'_isTopologicalRing (A := JetA K) n
  set P := IsTateRing.principalPair (JetA K) with hPdef
  refine continuous_of_continuousAt_zero
    (UnitDiscExample.restrictedGaussEquiv (JetA K) n).symm.toRingHom.toAddMonoidHom ?_
  rw [ContinuousAt, map_zero]
  rw [Metric.nhds_basis_ball.tendsto_right_iff]
  intro ε hε
  have hballA : Metric.ball (0 : JetA K) (ε / 2) ∈ nhds 0 :=
    Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨j, -, hjsub⟩ :=
    (P.toPairOfDefinition.hasBasis_nhds_zero).mem_iff.mp hballA
  have hsrc : (mvTateAlgNhd n P.toPairOfDefinition j :
      Set ↥(restrictedMvPowerSeriesSubring n (JetA K))) ∈
      @nhds _ (mvTateAlgebraTopology' (A := JetA K) n) 0 :=
    (mvTateAlgBasis' (A := JetA K) n).hasBasis_nhds_zero.mem_of_mem trivial
  refine Filter.eventually_iff_exists_mem.mpr ⟨_, hsrc, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
  have hcoeff : ∀ l : Fin n →₀ ℕ,
      ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff l
        ((UnitDiscExample.restrictedGaussEquiv (JetA K) n).symm y).1‖ ≤ ε / 2 := by
    intro l
    obtain ⟨b, hbI, hbeq⟩ := mvTateAlgNhd_coeff_mem n P.toPairOfDefinition j hy l
    have hmem : (b : JetA K) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : JetA K) (ε / 2) :=
      hjsub ⟨b, hbI, rfl⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hmem
    have hval : MvPowerSeries.coeff l
        ((UnitDiscExample.restrictedGaussEquiv (JetA K) n).symm y).1 =
        (b : JetA K) := by
      rw [hbeq]
      rfl
    rw [hval]
    exact hmem.le
  calc ‖(UnitDiscExample.restrictedGaussEquiv (JetA K) n).symm y‖
      = MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm (norm : JetA K → ℝ) (fun _ : Fin n => (1 : ℝ))
        ((UnitDiscExample.restrictedGaussEquiv (JetA K) n).symm y).1 :=
        MvRestricted.norm_eq _ _
    _ ≤ ε / 2 := by
        rw [MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm]
        refine Real.iSup_le (fun l => ?_) (by positivity)
        rw [finsupp_prod_one, mul_one]
        exact hcoeff l
    _ < ε := by linarith

name: ext_isSheafyFor
statement:
theorem ext_isSheafyFor (ϖ : Uniformizer K)
    (hK₀ : IsNoetherianRing (FiniteJet.unitBall K)) :
    IsSheafyFor (StrictLoc.PA K n) (extJetPlus K n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _i := (extJetPlus K n).toPlusSubring
  have : IsRingOfIntegralElements
      (((StrictLoc.PA K n)⁺ : Subring (StrictLoc.PA K n))) :=
    (extJetPlus K n).2
  have : HasLocLiftPowerBounded (StrictLoc.PA K n) := hasLocLiftPowerBounded_faithful
  have : IsSheafy (StrictLoc.PA K n) := isSheafy_extJetA K ϖ hK₀ n
  show IsLimitSheaf (StrictLoc.PA K n)
  exact isLimitSheaf_of_isSheafy

name: ext_isSheafyComplete
statement:
theorem ext_isSheafyComplete (ϖ : Uniformizer K)
    (hK₀ : IsNoetherianRing (FiniteJet.unitBall K)) :
    IsSheafyComplete (StrictLoc.PA K n)
proof:
:=
  (isSheafyFor_iff_isSheafyComplete (extJetPlus K n)).mp
    (ext_isSheafyFor K n ϖ hK₀)

name: ext_square_commutes
statement:
theorem ext_square_commutes (p : PA K m) :
    extRhoB K m (extJB K m p) = extRhoC K m (extIotaC K m p)
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  show MvPowerSeries.map (rhoB K) (MvPowerSeries.map (jB K) p.1) =
    MvPowerSeries.map (rhoC K) (MvPowerSeries.map (iotaC K) p.1)
  refine MvPowerSeries.ext fun s => ?_
  rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_map, MvPowerSeries.coeff_map, MvPowerSeries.coeff_map,
    MvPowerSeries.coeff_map]
  exact square_commutes K _

name: extRhoC_strict_surjective
statement:
theorem extRhoC_strict_surjective (d : PD K m) :
    ∃ c : PC K m, extRhoC K m c = d ∧ ‖c‖ = ‖d‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmem : MvPowerSeries.IsRestrictedGauss (fun _ : Fin m => (1 : ℝ))
      (fun s => sectionD K (MvPowerSeries.coeff s d.1)) := by
    have hd : MvPowerSeries.IsRestrictedGauss (fun _ : Fin m => (1 : ℝ)) d.1 := d.2
    unfold MvPowerSeries.IsRestrictedGauss at hd ⊢
    refine hd.congr fun s => ?_
    show ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff s d.1‖ * _ =
      ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff s (fun s => sectionD K (MvPowerSeries.coeff s d.1))‖ * _
    rw [show MvPowerSeries.coeff s (fun s => sectionD K (MvPowerSeries.coeff s d.1)) =
      sectionD K (MvPowerSeries.coeff s d.1) from rfl, norm_sectionD]
  refine ⟨⟨fun s => sectionD K (MvPowerSeries.coeff s d.1), hmem⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine Subtype.ext ?_
    show MvPowerSeries.map (rhoC K) (fun s => sectionD K (MvPowerSeries.coeff s d.1)) = d.1
    refine MvPowerSeries.ext fun s => ?_
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_map]
    show rhoC K (sectionD K (MvPowerSeries.coeff s d.1)) = MvPowerSeries.coeff s d.1
    rw [rhoC_sectionD]
  · rw [MvRestricted.norm_eq, MvRestricted.norm_eq, MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm,
      MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm]
    refine iSup_congr fun s => ?_
    show ‖MvPowerSeries.coeff s (fun s => sectionD K (MvPowerSeries.coeff s d.1))‖ * _ = _
    rw [show MvPowerSeries.coeff s (fun s => sectionD K (MvPowerSeries.coeff s d.1)) =
      sectionD K (MvPowerSeries.coeff s d.1) from rfl, norm_sectionD]

name: ext_milnorRow_exact
statement:
theorem ext_milnorRow_exact (b : PB K m) (c : PC K m)
    (h : extRhoB K m b = extRhoC K m c) :
    ∃! p : PA K m, extJB K m p = b ∧ extIotaC K m p = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcoeff : ∀ s : Fin m →₀ ℕ, rhoB K (MvPowerSeries.coeff s b.1) =
      rhoC K (MvPowerSeries.coeff s c.1) := fun s => by
    have h0 := congrArg (fun x : PD K m => MvPowerSeries.coeff s x.1) h
    show rhoB K (MvPowerSeries.coeff s b.1) = rhoC K (MvPowerSeries.coeff s c.1)
    have h1 : MvPowerSeries.coeff s (MvPowerSeries.map (rhoB K) b.1) =
        MvPowerSeries.coeff s (MvPowerSeries.map (rhoC K) c.1) := h0
    rwa [MvPowerSeries.coeff_map, MvPowerSeries.coeff_map] at h1
  have hmem : ∀ s, MvPowerSeries.coeff s c.1 ∈ jetSupport K := fun s =>
    (mem_jetSupport_iff_jet_in_range K _).mpr ⟨MvPowerSeries.coeff s b.1, hcoeff s⟩
  have hres : MvPowerSeries.IsRestrictedGauss (fun _ : Fin m => (1 : ℝ))
      (fun s => (⟨MvPowerSeries.coeff s c.1, hmem s⟩ : JetA K)) := by
    have hc : MvPowerSeries.IsRestrictedGauss (fun _ : Fin m => (1 : ℝ)) c.1 := c.2
    unfold MvPowerSeries.IsRestrictedGauss at hc ⊢
    exact hc.congr fun s => rfl
  refine ⟨⟨fun s => (⟨MvPowerSeries.coeff s c.1, hmem s⟩ : JetA K), hres⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · refine Subtype.ext ?_
    show MvPowerSeries.map (jB K)
      (fun s => (⟨MvPowerSeries.coeff s c.1, hmem s⟩ : JetA K)) = b.1
    refine MvPowerSeries.ext fun s => ?_
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_map]
    obtain ⟨a, ⟨hab, hac⟩, -⟩ := milnorRow_exact K (MvPowerSeries.coeff s b.1)
      (MvPowerSeries.coeff s c.1) (hcoeff s)
    have hpa : (⟨MvPowerSeries.coeff s c.1, hmem s⟩ : JetA K) = a :=
      Subtype.ext (show MvPowerSeries.coeff s c.1 = (a : JetC K) from hac.symm)
    show jB K (⟨MvPowerSeries.coeff s c.1, hmem s⟩ : JetA K) = _
    rw [hpa, hab]
  · refine Subtype.ext ?_
    show MvPowerSeries.map (iotaC K)
      (fun s => (⟨MvPowerSeries.coeff s c.1, hmem s⟩ : JetA K)) = c.1
    refine MvPowerSeries.ext fun s => ?_
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_map]
    rfl
  · rintro q ⟨-, hqc⟩
    refine Subtype.ext (MvPowerSeries.ext fun s => ?_)
    have h1 := congrArg (fun x : PC K m => MvPowerSeries.coeff s x.1) hqc
    have h2 : MvPowerSeries.coeff s (MvPowerSeries.map (iotaC K) q.1) =
        MvPowerSeries.coeff s c.1 := h1
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_map] at h2
    show MvPowerSeries.coeff s q.1 = _
    exact Subtype.ext h2

name: ext_max_norm_eq
statement:
theorem ext_max_norm_eq (p : PA K m) :
    max ‖extJB K m p‖ ‖extIotaC K m p‖ = ‖p‖
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ‖extIotaC K m p‖ = ‖p‖ := by
    rw [MvRestricted.norm_eq, MvRestricted.norm_eq]
    show MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm _ _ (MvPowerSeries.map (iotaC K) p.1) = _
    rw [MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm, MvPowerSeries.gaussNorm]
    refine iSup_congr fun s => ?_
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_map, norm_iotaC]
  have h2 : ‖extJB K m p‖ ≤ ‖p‖ := norm_mapRestricted_le _ _ _ p
  rw [h1]
  exact max_eq_right h2

name: ext_pair_injective
statement:
theorem ext_pair_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun p : PA K m => (extJB K m p, extIotaC K m p))
proof:
:= by
  intro p q h
  have h2 : extIotaC K m p = extIotaC K m q := congrArg Prod.snd h
  have hinj : Function.Injective (iotaC K) := fun a b hab => Subtype.ext hab
  exact Subtype.ext (MvPowerSeries.map_injective hinj (congrArg Subtype.val h2))

name: span_pushed_B
statement:
theorem span_pushed_B (hspan : Ideal.span ({g} ∪ Set.range f) = ⊤) :
    Ideal.span ({jB K g} ∪ Set.range (fun i => jB K (f i))) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (Ideal.map (jB K)) hspan
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_top] at h

name: mapRestricted_polyToP
statement:
theorem mapRestricted_polyToP {E E' : Type*} [NormedCommRing E] [IsUltrametricDist E]
    [NormOneClass E] [CompleteSpace E] [NormedCommRing E'] [IsUltrametricDist E']
    [NormOneClass E'] [CompleteSpace E']
    (φ : E →+* E') (hφ : ∀ x, ‖φ x‖ ≤ ‖x‖) (q : MvPolynomial (Fin m) E) :
    mapRestricted φ hφ (fun _ : Fin m => (1 : ℝ)) (polyToP q) =
      polyToP (MvPolynomial.map φ q)
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (MvPowerSeries.ext fun s => ?_)
  show MvPowerSeries.coeff s (MvPowerSeries.map φ ((polyToP (E := E) (m := m) q)).1) = _
  rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_map, coeff_polyToP, coeff_polyToP, MvPolynomial.coeff_map]

name: rB_eq
statement:
theorem rB_eq (i : Fin m) : rB K m g f i =
    polyToP (MvPolynomial.C (jB K g) * MvPolynomial.X i -
      MvPolynomial.C (jB K (f i)))
proof:
:= by
  show mapRestricted (jB K) (norm_jB_le K) _ (polyToP _) = _
  rw [mapRestricted_polyToP]
  congr 1
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, MvPolynomial.map_C, MvPolynomial.map_X, MvPolynomial.map_C]

name: rC_eq
statement:
theorem rC_eq (i : Fin m) : rC K m g f i =
    polyToP (MvPolynomial.C (iotaC K g) * MvPolynomial.X i -
      MvPolynomial.C (iotaC K (f i)))
proof:
:= by
  show mapRestricted (iotaC K) (fun a => le_of_eq (norm_iotaC K a)) _ (polyToP _) = _
  rw [mapRestricted_polyToP]
  congr 1
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, MvPolynomial.map_C, MvPolynomial.map_X, MvPolynomial.map_C]

name: rD_eq
statement:
theorem rD_eq (i : Fin m) : rD K m g f i =
    polyToP (MvPolynomial.C (rhoC K (iotaC K g)) * MvPolynomial.X i -
      MvPolynomial.C (rhoC K (iotaC K (f i))))
proof:
:= by
  show mapRestricted (rhoC K) (norm_rhoC_le K) _ (rC K m g f i) = _
  rw [rC_eq, mapRestricted_polyToP]
  congr 1
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, MvPolynomial.map_C, MvPolynomial.map_X, MvPolynomial.map_C]

name: extRhoB_rB

name: isNoetherianRing_restricted_L
statement:
theorem isNoetherianRing_restricted_L (ϖ : Uniformizer K)
    (hK₀ : IsNoetherianRing (unitBall K)) (k : ℕ) :
    IsNoetherianRing (restrictedMvPowerSeriesSubring k (L K))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := ϖ.isStronglyNoetherian hK₀
  
  obtain ⟨e1, he1⟩ := UnitDiscExample.exists_flatten' K
    (MvPowerSeries.Restricted K (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℝ))) (RingEquiv.refl _)
    (fun _ => rfl) 1
  
  obtain ⟨e2, -⟩ := UnitDiscExample.exists_flatten'
    (MvPowerSeries.Restricted K (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℝ)))
    (MvPowerSeries.Restricted K (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 : ℝ)))
    e1.symm
    (fun x => by
      have h := he1 (e1.symm x)
      rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
      exact h.symm) k
  
  obtain ⟨e3, -⟩ := UnitDiscExample.exists_flatten' K
    (MvPowerSeries.Restricted K (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℝ))) (RingEquiv.refl _)
    (fun _ => rfl) (k + 1)
  haveI hK : IsNoetherianRing (restrictedMvPowerSeriesSubring (k + 2) K) :=
    IsStronglyNoetherian.isNoetherianRing_restricted (k + 2)
  refine isNoetherianRing_of_surjective (restrictedMvPowerSeriesSubring (k + 2) K) _
    (((UnitDiscExample.restrictedGaussEquiv (L K) k).toRingHom).comp
      ((mapRestrictedGauss k (evalHom (R := K)) (evalHom_norm_le (R := K))).comp
        (((UnitDiscExample.restrictedGaussEquiv K (k + 2)).symm.trans
          (e3.symm.trans e2.symm)).toRingHom))) ?_
  rw [RingHom.coe_comp, RingHom.coe_comp]
  exact (RingEquiv.surjective _).comp
    ((mapRestrictedGauss_surjective k (evalHom (R := K)) (evalHom_norm_le (R := K))
      (evalHom_exists_norm_le (R := K))).comp (RingEquiv.surjective _))

name: isNoetherianRing_unitBall_restricted_L
statement:
theorem isNoetherianRing_unitBall_restricted_L (ϖ : Uniformizer K)
    (hK₀ : IsNoetherianRing (unitBall K)) (k : ℕ) :
    IsNoetherianRing (unitBall
      (MvPowerSeries.Restricted (L K) (fun _ : Fin k => (1 : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e1, he1⟩ := UnitDiscExample.exists_flatten' K
    (MvPowerSeries.Restricted K (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℝ))) (RingEquiv.refl _)
    (fun _ => rfl) 1
  obtain ⟨e2, he2⟩ := UnitDiscExample.exists_flatten'
    (MvPowerSeries.Restricted K (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℝ)))
    (MvPowerSeries.Restricted K (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 : ℝ)))
    e1.symm
    (fun x => by
      have h := he1 (e1.symm x)
      rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
      exact h.symm) k
  obtain ⟨e3, he3⟩ := UnitDiscExample.exists_flatten' K
    (MvPowerSeries.Restricted K (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℝ))) (RingEquiv.refl _)
    (fun _ => rfl) (k + 1)
  have h23 := isNoetherianRing_unitBall_of_isometry e3.symm
    (fun x => by
      have h := he3 (e3.symm x)
      rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
      exact h.symm) (ϖ.isNoetherianRing_unitBall_P hK₀ (k + 2))
  have h3 := isNoetherianRing_unitBall_of_isometry e2.symm
    (fun x => by
      have h := he2 (e2.symm x)
      rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
      exact h.symm) h23
  exact isNoetherianRing_unitBall_of_section
    (mapRestrictedGauss k (evalHom (R := K)) (evalHom_norm_le (R := K)))
    (norm_mapRestrictedGauss_le k (evalHom (R := K)) (evalHom_norm_le (R := K)))
    (mapRestrictedGauss_exists_norm_le k (evalHom (R := K)) (evalHom_norm_le (R := K))
      (evalHom_exists_norm_le (R := K))) h3

    (evalHom_exists_norm_le (R := K)) (ϖ.isNoetherianRing_unitBall_P hK₀ 2)
